findings.title: 404 on /api/auth/get-session when loading /builder
findings.detail: Navigating to /builder triggered a network 404: GET /api/auth/get-session returned 404 Not Found. Session/auth endpoint appears missing.
findings.expected: Auth session endpoint should return 200 with session info (or not be called).

findings.title: "New blank workflow" does not create a blank workflow
findings.detail: In /builder → File menu → clicked "New blank workflow". The canvas still shows the pre-existing 37-block "Working FAPI Workbook Preparation Demo" with 196 connections and the same title. No new blank canvas was created.
findings.expected: An empty canvas with a new untitled workflow.

findings.title: Builder config dialog is a full-screen 1800px modal that blocks all toolbar interaction
findings.detail: After adding a block, a centered fixed modal (w-min(96vw,1800px)) opened and intercepted pointer events for Add/Save/canvas until explicitly closed. There's no obvious dismiss affordance in the accessibility outline; had to target [aria-label=Close]. Makes iterative building awkward.
findings.expected: Config should be a side panel or easily dismissible, not block the whole toolbar.

findings.title: Document upload fails: 503 on /api/documents/upload-url
findings.detail: On /documents, uploading the sample company tax file triggered POST /api/documents/upload-url → 503 Service Unavailable. GET /api/documents confirms zero documents stored. The upload/RAG flow is non-functional.
findings.expected: Upload should return a signed URL (200), store the file, and the document should appear in /api/documents.

findings.title: Newly added block is orphaned and un-configurable due to blocking modal
findings.detail: Added block #38 "Uploaded Workbook" persisted after Save/navigation, but connection count stayed at 196 (0 new edges) and I could not rename/configure/connect it because the full-screen config modal blocked the toolbar/canvas. The block carries a generic label with no custom config, so it cannot represent a meaningful workflow-A step.
findings.expected: A newly added block should be connectable and configurable (label, inputs) without a blocking modal, and should support drawing edges.

findings.title: Sina cannot describe the builder workflow — returns garbled "UC" response
findings.detail: Asked Sina twice to describe the steps of my "Working FAPI Workbook Preparation Demo" workflow and which blocks feed the Calculation Engine. Both times the assistant response rendered only the literal text "UC" with no actual description. The app cannot introspect/describe the workflow's steps or data lineage on request.
findings.expected: Sina should describe the ordered steps and identify which source/logic blocks feed the Calculation Engine and what the output produces.
